parts.gloss: particle of regret or past state

literal: Self-control possessor I would say indeed, as for me; my love, secret transgressing, in the public place will appear.
translation: I used to boast that I possessed self-control; but my love, breaking past all secrecy, now stands revealed in the public square.
modern: நான் மனக்கட்டுப்பாடு உடையவள் என்றுதான் சொல்லிக்கொண்டிருந்தேன்; ஆனால் என் காமமானது இரகசியத்தைக் கடந்து பொதுவெளியில் வெளிப்பட்டு நிற்கிறது.
explanation: The heroine laments her inability to conceal her intense love-sickness. She recalls how she once believed she had the strength and self-control (niṟai) to keep her feelings hidden. However, her passion (kāmam) has grown so powerful that it has broken through all boundaries of secrecy (maṟai) and is now visible to everyone in the public square (maṉṟu). The particle 'maṉ' highlights her past confidence, which has now turned into helpless exposure.
